tools.name: search_protein_structures
tools.title: Search protein structures (RCSB PDB)
tools.description: Search RCSB PDB protein structures by free text, UniProt accession, bound ligand component ID or amino-acid sequence, and return ranked entries with title, method, resolution, organisms, UniProt IDs and bound ligands. Criteria are combined with AND; a drug may appear in PDB under its code name (sotorasib = AMG 510, component MOV). Summary view by default (up to 10 entries); view "full" adds ligand SMILES and polymer entities (up to 25). (한국어: 단백질 구조 검색, PDB 검색, 리간드 결합 구조 찾기, 서열로 구조 찾기, 신약개발 표적 구조)

query.description: Free text, e.g. "KRAS G12C covalent inhibitor".

ligand_id.description: PDB chemical component ID of a bound ligand, e.g. MOV (sotorasib).

tools.name: fetch_protein_structure
tools.title: Fetch a PDB structure for 3D viewing
tools.description: Download one exact RCSB PDB entry (mmCIF or PDB) and save it with a Mol* view state and RCSB's rendered assembly image under agentlas-structures/<ID>/ in the working folder, returning entry facts, chains, ligand instances, content SHA-256 and a molstarView artifact in the agentlas.source-to-molstar shape. focus_ligand_id centres the view on a bound ligand. (한국어: 단백질 3D 구조 보기, PDB 구조 가져오기, 분자 구조 3차원 보기, Mol* 보기, mmCIF 다운로드)

annotations.title: Fetch a PDB structure for 3D viewing

tools.name: fetch_alphafold_model
tools.title: Fetch an AlphaFold DB predicted structure
tools.description: Fetch the AlphaFold DB predicted structure for a UniProt accession, summarize per-residue pLDDT confidence (mean, confidence bands, low-confidence segments) and save the model with a Mol* view state under agentlas-structures/<model ID>/. pLDDT is model confidence, not experimental evidence. (한국어: 알파폴드 예측 구조, AlphaFold 구조 가져오기, 예측 단백질 구조 신뢰도 pLDDT)

annotations.title: Fetch an AlphaFold DB predicted structure

tools.name: describe_binding_site
tools.title: Describe a ligand binding site
tools.description: Compute the residues around a bound ligand in one PDB entry from its deposited coordinates: residues with any heavy atom within the radius (default 4.5 Å) sorted by distance, contact counts, covalent bonds declared in the entry and short heavy-atom pairs, nearby cofactors, plus a Mol* residue-interaction focus on the ligand. (한국어: 리간드 결합 부위, 결합 포켓 잔기, 공유결합 위치, 단백질-리간드 복합체 상호작용 요약)

ligand_id.description: PDB chemical component ID, e.g. MOV for sotorasib in 6OIM.

tools.name: fetch_chembl_activities
tools.title: Fetch ChEMBL bioactivity (IC50, Ki)
tools.description: Fetch ChEMBL bioactivity records (IC50, Ki, Kd, EC50, GI50, Inhibition) for a molecule and/or target, resolving names to ChEMBL IDs, optionally keeping only a mutant such as G12C, and return per-molecule aggregates (median nM, pChEMBL) with the strongest records and assay descriptions. Summary view by default. (한국어: 생물활성, IC50 값, 약효 데이터, ChEMBL 활성, 저해 농도 비교)

target_query.description: Target name, e.g. KRAS; a human single protein is preferred.

molecule_name.description: Drug or compound name, e.g. sotorasib.

mutation.description: Keep records for this variant only, e.g. G12C.

tools.name: fetch_clinical_trials
tools.title: Search ClinicalTrials.gov registrations
tools.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov (API v2) registrations by intervention, condition or free term with phase and status filters, returning NCT ID, title, acronym, phase, status, enrollment, dates, sponsor, conditions and interventions; view "full" adds summaries, primary outcomes, arms and country counts. Registry entries are protocols, not efficacy results. (한국어: 임상시험 등록 조회, 임상 단계, NCT 번호, 임상 진행 상태)

tools.name: describe_structural_biology_capabilities
tools.title: Describe structural biology capabilities
tools.description: Return the providers, guards, artifact contract and limitations of this plugin. (한국어: 구조생물학 플러그인 기능 설명)
